title: M7.P5: Parse named suite results in qualification acceptance
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

The strict parser requires the exact15 named suite rows and refuses failed/missing/duplicate controls. Fresh acceptance02 ends0 after verifying original QA20 rc1, corrected scripts1378/0/0, fourteen other suites,324 protocol assertions, reviewed frames and actual shutdown. Upgrade20 consumes a hash-bound composed receipt and ends0. Original parser01/QA20 failures remain. See [regression and acceptance controls](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-regression-fixtures) and [corrected clean/upgrade qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-pixelelated-replacement-20).

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

Parent: #344, M7.P5. Found while composing completed replacement20 qualification under the owner’s instruction to fix every gap before device builds.

## Current behavior and code trace
The new host-only acceptance wrapper’s table regex included the Markdown separator `---` as a suite, then safely refused its expected count. Original QA20 and both corrected script results are unchanged; acceptance owner01 ends1. This is a report-parser defect, not a firmware/test failure.
Already written: only a failed acceptance-wrapper log; no guest or owner data changed.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — host fixtures parse the actual VM report and controlled malformed variants, with no device action.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Exact named suite rows are parsed without the header/separator; failed, missing and duplicate-suite controls are refused with retained results.
- [x] A fresh supervised acceptance consumes original QA20 failure and corrected regression success, checks all remaining suites/protocols/frames and actual shutdown, and permits upgrade only with explicit passing composed evidence. Original failures remain unchanged.
